control_failures.control_label: insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: preventive action - alarm philosophy conformance on B-8201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on B-8201 and PSV-8201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in protecting people from hot surfaces, specifically insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces. B-8201 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 22 December 2024 a corrective action on B-8201 and PSV-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
